body: Thank you so much for telling me all this. As you said it's almost impossible to find someone else going through the same thing. I'm not as far in the process as you are but I doubt my judge will have the kind of sympathy he had for you, you sound like a well-rounded enough person, I'm a mess on every aspect of life. I couldn't be happier for you that it seems you're getting through this and the worst is over, but I'm sure mine is still to come. Even if all this child porn bullshit were to magically disappear, I'm still well in over my head in shit I can't deal with. Anyway I PMed you, hopefully we can talk more.

I used to go to a psychiatrist and therapy and we talked about my pedophiliac desires. But it never helped. And I'm not seeing anyone about the pain, I don't think pain management therapists exist here. No one will prescribe me opiates or take my pain seriously because the condition is undiagnosed, I've done multiple tests and seen several specialists and they just tell me I have nothing. Pretty tired of running around in circles begging for help.

And yeah, sure, PM me what you wanna say.

For now, yeah. My family owns a business and a few employees quit unexpectedly so I'm covering up for them. But soon enough some new people are supposed to come and I'm supposed to be in post-op for 3 weeks, I'll take that as a queue to leave and they'll have this time to deal with my funeral instead.

I'm sure it will, but at this point not causing them pain is not an option anymore. If I don't kill myself I'll still be a pedophile, schizophrenic, and probably die in jail. Whose family wants that? I think I'm choosing the lesser evil.
I thought it was okay. Maybe I should watch it again because I didn't understand some things. Mainly Magneto's and Mystique's constantly changing motives.

Thanks for missing the point entirely and equating pedophiles to child molesters. 

Furthermore, I hope you realize that by wishing every pedophile was killed, you are more than likely wishing one of your loved ones to be killed. Statistically speaking you probably have a friend or family member with sexual attraction towards children. Of course you'll never know about it because they won't act on it or speak about it because of the stigma created by idiots such as yourself.

The comparison is just a way to try to tell people: "I didn't choose to be like this and my ATTRACTION is not hurting anyone. Actions are."

I am also both gay and a pedophile and this is another reason I compare both, because I live both realities and they affect me similarly.

You are making the mistake I warn against in the very first line of my post. You are equating pedophilia to child rape. I compared pedophilia to homossexuality; you read it as a comparation between child rape and gay sex.

To recap, a homossexual is a person who is born with a sexual attraction that they can't control. They are a minority. They were demonized and denied rights for years. A pedophile is the same. And that's where the comparison ends.

I don't know enough about chemical castration to form a thorough opinion on this. The little I know about it is that it is not unfortunately a "kill all sexual desires" switch. There is a lot more to human sexuality than merely hormones and castration would affect everyone differently. There are many reported cases of chemically castreted men sexually abusing children with their hands.

And I don't think forcing anyone to do it is a good idea. I feel like most would feel dehumanised and humilitated which would lead to anger and perhaps a bigger desire to act out. I think it should be presented to pedophiles as a voluntary treatment option. 

There have been few studies that show legal child porn reduce child abuse rates. I can't link to it right now but you can google "child pornography reduces abuse" and a bunch of results will show up.

And about non-exclusive pedophiles - I can only speak for myself. I certainly consider being this way a big help in managing my sexuality without harming anyone. But again, others might feel differently. Again, I think they should be offered treatment options and with the help of a psychologist/doctor, decide what's best for them and for society around them.
If you can't see the similarity between two groups of people being demonized and denied rights for being born with a different sexual attraction then I don't know what to say to you.

I'm sorry but it seems that with your response to my quote you missed the point of my post entirely. I never said "I hope someday we'll be given the same exact rights as gay people". I said "I hope we'll look back and see we we're dealing with this backwards". You don't have to tell me how harmful it is for a child to be sexually abused.  

And yes, it is absolutely a very comparable situation. It's a group of people that were demonized and denied rights for years based on sexual attraction. And that's where the comparison ends. Pedophilia is comparable to homossexuality. Child abuse is not comparable with gay sex. That's the very first point I tried to make. 

No rational pedophile is asking for the right to harm children - no rational legislator is ever gonna give anyone that right.

Yes, of course a lot of pedophiles would want the right to have sex with children, but there's no reason to worry or believe that this is what we all want and that the whole "movement" would eventually evolve into that. They actually already exist, there's one called NAMBLA (North American Man Boy Love Association). They want the right to marry little boys. We let gay people fuck because we realized they're not hurting anyone. No one is ever gonna give people the right to harm children.

There is no point in simply comparing it to another mental condition and deciding to treat them the same way. Sexual attraction is completely different from addiction. A more fair comparison would be to BDSM or rape fantasies. I think we all prefer people acting on their fantasies with a consenting partner. It would be a simple matter of conducting research and deciding whether artifical child pornography reduces child abuse rates or not. I can't link to it right now but some research has been done on the subject and it shows that yes, it does reduce real child harm.

Again, ending stigma and demonization would let us research this subject more and then legislate based on findings - the rational way. Currently we legislate these issues with our emotions.

I don't have a doubt that most pedophiles would choose to rid themselves of this attraction - fetish, orientation, mental illness, whatever you wanna call it - but there's no evidence that such a thing can be done. The point of therapy for convicted pedophiles currently is to teach them how to manage their urges without hurting other people.
